text: Add occasional web research capability to discovery loop
description: Enable agent to perform targeted web research when encountering unknowns or needing current best practices. During PLANNING or DISCOVERING states, agent can search for documentation, tutorials, Stack Overflow discussions, library comparisons, etc. Research results inform strategy and create context for decisions. Should be occasional/on-demand, not constant - agent decides when research is needed based on knowledge gaps.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026 as a product implementation aim: targeted web research is already an agent capability and should be invoked by concrete aims when current information is needed. No separate generic subsystem is justified.

reflection: Preserved the useful intention—research current unknowns when needed—while removing an unnecessary implementation abstraction. Evidence and findings belong on the concrete aim they inform.
